<div class="card-body">
'''He Hasn't Come Back Yet''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">彼はまだ戻っていません</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに、自分の屋外の惑星位置に単独でいる任意のキャラクターを目標とする。ただしドッキング・ベイは除く。運命数を引く。運命数＋3＞能力値なら目標は行方不明になる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-He-Hasnt-Come-Back-Yet-PSA-88099878.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「レイア姫がルーク様のことを心配しておられます。どこに居られるのか御存じないそうで。私も存じません。誰も知っておられないようなのです」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' He Hasn't Come Back Yet.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, target any character alone at your exterior planet location. Docking bays are excluded. Draw destiny. If destiny +3 exceeds ability, the target becomes missing.

'''Lore:'''
Princess Leia is worried about Master Luke. She does not know where he is. I do not know either. Nobody knows where he is.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text uses 位置 for site and 行方不明 for missing.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[He Hasn't Come Back Yet]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
